title: 60 SQL Practice Queries on PostgreSQL
summary: Sixty solved SQL drills on PostgreSQL over an employees/departments/orders schema, ordered from basic filtering through aggregates, joins, subqueries, window functions and CTEs to classic interview scenarios. Each drill gives the task, the solution code and the exact result.

chapters.title: 60 SQL Queries, PostgreSQL
points: 60 practice queries with answers
Engine: PostgreSQL 16
Schema: employees, departments, orders
Seven task families from basics to interview scenarios

chapters.title: The Practice Schema
points: departments(id, name, location) with sample rows
employees(id, name, email, dept_id, manager_id, salary, hire_date, job_title) with sample rows
orders(id, employee_id, customer, amount, order_date, status) with sample rows
Why manager_id is nullable and self-referencing
How to read each drill: task, solution, result
